research.title: BIPM — The International System of Units,9th edition,V4.01June2026
research.retrieval: Actual102page official PDF, focused text5.4.1–4 and5.4.7 plus copyright. Not a claim of reading entirePDF or rendered-page audit.
research.use: Quantity values combine number and referenceunit; numerical values depend on chosenunit. Decimal comma/point and often-implicit unit1.
research.ageAdaptation: Adult reference translated into two concrete examples; advanced notation not a learner prerequisite. Not evidence of this lesson efficacy or a new Finnish curriculum requirement.
research.licence: PDF states CCBY4.0. BIPM credited/link retained; original Finnish prose and diagrams, no source figures copied.

research.title: NIST — Guide to the SI,Chapter7
research.retrieval: OfficialHTML7.1 and distinction of quantity vs numerical-value equations read.
research.use: A number alone is not the same object as a quantity value. Unit changes require considering the associated numerical value.
research.ageAdaptation: Brief contextual records, no formal quantity calculus required; conversion factor/results supplied.
research.licence: Conceptual corroboration/link, no copied figure or long prose. Do not assume third-party media cleared.

research.title: NPL — Measurement
research.retrieval: OfficialHTML measurement definition, reference comparison and example.
research.use: Start with an observable property/reference, then notation, rather than treating unit as a decorative string.
research.ageAdaptation: Use safe paper/tape demonstration; distinguish model readings from actual instrument operation.
research.licence: Original adaptation and link only. No page media/prose reproduced, no blanket reuse licence assumed.
